patch.value: Warm, damp air smells of soil and squashed pumpkin. Big Bertha lies split open in her soil bed, under a toppled bench and broken pots. A smashed side window lets in a chilly breeze.

Warm, damp air smells of soil and squashed pumpkin. Big Bertha lies split open in her soil bed, under a toppled bench and broken pots. A smashed side window lets in a chilly breeze, and its broken glass lies scattered across the greenhouse floor.
